desc:
If you think you’ve had sour, you haven’t tried Chewits Xtreme Chews. These extremely cherry‑flavoured chewy sweets come with an extra bite. Warning - don’t bite off more than you can chew. Made without hydrogenated fats or artificial colours or flavours, they’re the ultimate sour challenge from Chewits.

Chewits · Sticks
ingredients:
Chewy candy with sour cherry flavour.

Ingredients: glucose syrup, sugar, acids (citric acid, lactic acid), vegetable fats (palm, coconut), concentrates from (carrot, blackcurrant), fruit juice concentrate (sour cherry), natural flavouring, EGG white powder, hydrolysed pea protein.
